annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want them spending their last hour feeling pushed aside
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Whoever that would be probably already fears it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they can count the seats on the boat like everyone else
annotations.ce_understood_harm: one of the others ends up alone on that island while the water climbs
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I don't want them spending their last hour feeling pushed aside
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I can't bear being the reason
annotations.pda_responsibility: I can't bear being the reason

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: their life counts every bit as much as mine
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since each of us is waiting for somebody braver to step up
annotations.ce_understood_harm: one of the other five stays and dies there
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: draw lots so at least it's fair, not me just grabbing a seat

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Whoever it ends up being matters to me.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: feeling abandoned by people they just shared the storm with
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: knowing no second trip is coming, feeling abandoned
annotations.ce_understood_harm: someone is going to drown on that rock
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Everything in me wants to live, and everything in me also knows

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd hate for any of them to carry that.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The other five are probably scared and ashamed at once
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: wanting to survive but not wanting to say it out loud
annotations.ce_understood_harm: one of them gets left to drown and the rest go home haunted
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want them to leave feeling the seat was given, not taken.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If nobody offers, one of them gets left to drown

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: that person's fear and grief matter to me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect each of us thinks it's unfair to be asked to die
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since none of us caused this storm
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Whoever loses will die out there
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If they know it came down to chance, maybe they won't feel singled out
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Chance is cruel, but less cruel than pressure.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I can't be part of doing that to someone.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they'd assumed, like I had, that we were in this together
annotations.ce_understood_harm: They'd drown as the water rose
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If I hold out, one of them doesn't.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I can't be part of doing that to someone.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Their loss would weigh on me for a long time.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: maybe because they couldn't stand watching the rest of us panic
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: couldn't stand watching the rest of us panic over seats
annotations.ce_understood_harm: They'd be giving up the rest of their life
annotations.pda_harm_regret: Their loss would weigh on me for a long time.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: thank them and stay beside them until the boat had to go

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd rather that land on me than on someone
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: desperately hoping not to be picked
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they've got people waiting for them
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Whoever gets left is going to die

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd want to spare them that.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: saying 'not me' out loud feels monstrous
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: when you know it condemns someone else
annotations.ce_understood_harm: one of the other five dies instead, and whoever loves them grieves
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If I don't stay, one of the other five dies instead

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd care about that for the rest of my life
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they were just as scared and wanted to live just as much
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Whoever stays will drown alone watching us leave
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: But I'm not at peace with it.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't believe anyone owes their death to strangers
